generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Karnataka Public Procurement Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Karnataka Public Procurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees is as per KPPP generate
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1 percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.

All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner. ( section 3 & 4 of the bid document ) and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Tenderer. Necessary Certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents Section can be used for this purpose.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.

The Tenderer should submit proposed methodology and program of construction, backed with equipment and materials duly supported with broad calculations and quality management, plan, proposed to be adopted, justifying of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications within the stipulated period of completion.
Department will not supply any materials.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the right to reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.
The Tenderers should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.

The contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009. As per EPF & MP act 1952 in respect of the employees angaged by or through contractors, agencies and contractors shall have provident fund code no. & all the contract employees deployed by them are enrolled as members of provident fund.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in E-Karnataka Public Procurement Portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
The Contractor should maintain the road in good condition for smooth and safe vehicle transportation till end of the defect liability period.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Haveri during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned.
Work Completion/ Execution Period : 06 Months

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.23.99 lakhs Credit lines/letter of credit/ certificates from the banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. (Certificate should be as per format mentioned in the GO No.FD-CAM/16/2022(P-2)Dated: 12-08-2022 attached and conditional LOC is not accepted Otherwise tender will be rejected)
DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD: The Defects Liability Period is 365 days. The Defects Liability period starts, after successful completion of work
Any Deviation/Error/mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the Unified SR 2023-24 (continued for 2026-27) and subsequent Corrigendums and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.

The EMD of Rs.160000/shall be made through e-payment or in Two parts-Part (1) Rs. 50,000 /- by e-payment Part (2) Rs.110000/- Shall be in the form of Bank Guarantee/FDR, in the prescribed format, obtained from any Nationalized / Scheduled bank in favor of Executive Engineer, PWD, Division, Haveri which should be scanned & uploaded to the e Karnataka Public Procurement Portal while submitting the tender. Original Bank Guarantee /FDR of the part (2) of EMD shall be delivered to the Executive Engineer, PWD, Division, Haveri at the time of agreement.
